title: Integrated terminal opens but shows no command output
symptom_summary: The integrated terminal opens and remains blank when the reporter tries to run a command. The report does not say whether keystrokes are visible.
repro_steps: Open a project in VS Code.
Open a new integrated terminal and try a command such as dir.

title: Problem opening the integrated terminal after an update
symptom_summary: The reporter noticed a problem when opening the integrated terminal after installing an update. The exact behavior and error are not specified in the text.
repro_steps: Open the integrated terminal after updating VS Code.

title: PowerShell integrated terminal repeatedly creates new lines
symptom_summary: After updating to VS Code 1.112.0, the integrated PowerShell terminal continuously creates new lines. The reporter cannot type or stop it with Ctrl+C.

title: Text doubles and changes size when integrated terminals are split
symptom_summary: With two or more terminals in a split group, one pane shows doubled and incorrectly sized text. The symptom clears only after closing all terminals.
repro_steps: Open two or more integrated terminals.
